backend/main.mo: Motoko canister implementing user access control, login tracking, user stats, availability records, and chat storage with admin-only deletion APIs.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report listing calendar UI changes and associated files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing the purpose of each frontend file across hooks, pages, components, and styles.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base/theme configuration defining OKLCH color variables and global styling for light and dark modes.
frontend/index.html: Minimal HTML shell loading the React application root and main entry script.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React entry setting up routing, authentication gate, profile setup flow, and global layout wrapper.
frontend/src/components/auth/AccessDenie: UI screen shown when a user without admin permissions attempts to access a restricted page.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginScreen: Login UI integrating Internet Identity with simple branding and sign‑in button.
frontend/src/components/chat/ChatPanel.t: Embedded chat component showing recent messages with sender names, timestamps, and a send form.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppLayout: Layout wrapper including top bar, navigation, main content container, and footer with attribution.
frontend/src/components/layout/Navigatio: Renders a navigation bar with dynamic items, highlighting the active route and adding an admin link if the user is an admin.
frontend/src/components/layout/TopBar.ts: Displays the app header with logo, theme toggle, user menu, and logout handling tied to Internet Identity.
frontend/src/components/profile/ProfileS: Shows a modal prompting the user to enter and save their name using a profile mutation.
frontend/src/components/theme/Background: Wraps children with a full‑screen background image layer.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Initializes and manages the backend actor based on identity, refetching dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useCurrentUserProfile: Provides hooks to get and update the caller's user profile using the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useCurrentUserRole.ts: Fetches the caller's role and whether they are an admin via actor queries.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Manages Internet Identity authentication state, loading, login, and logout via AuthClient.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Collection of data hooks for profiles, leaderboard, availability, messaging, and stats using the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useTheme.ts: Manages light/dark theme state persisted in local storage and toggles document classes.
frontend/src/hooks/useUserDirectory.ts: Looks up display names for principals by fetching profiles and exposing a directory map.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind base styles and CSS variables for light and dark themes.
frontend/src/lib/date.ts: Provides date utilities for converting dates to bigint IDs, formatting, and generating month/day grids.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with React Query and Internet Identity providers.
frontend/src/pages/AddAvailabilityPage.t: Form page for adding or editing daily availability with time slots and notes.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPage.tsx: Admin panel for deleting users or day data and viewing login activity.
frontend/src/pages/CalendarMonthPage.tsx: Monthly calendar view showing days, availability indicators, and navigation controls.
frontend/src/pages/ChatPage.tsx: Simple wrapper page displaying the group chat panel.
frontend/src/pages/DayDetailPage.tsx: Displays all player availabilities for a specific day with user details and notes.
frontend/src/pages/LeaderboardPage.tsx: Shows player rankings with filters and allows users to record wins/losses.
frontend/src/pages/ProfilePage.tsx: Renders a user profile page showing fetched stats, win percentage, streak info, and placeholder sections for match history and settings.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides helpers for reading URL parameters, persisting them in sessionStorage, and managing hash-based query cleanup.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind with custom colors, animations, container behavior, plugins, and extended theme settings.
project_state.json: Describes the project’s state and requirements for calendar UI fixes involving indicator placement and calendar width adjustments.
